name: Wynrou
source:
The Magician of February / The Purification Magician

Always upbeat and smiling pleasantly, Wynrou spends his energy taking naps most of the time. He's actually a very cynical and cold person, but tries his best to hide that fact from Iris.

The most knowledgeable Magician when it comes to souls. Previously known as Airy [spoiler]before the battle with his brother Februum, which fractured both of their powers[/spoiler].

After eons of fighting corrupted spirits as his role and to help humans, it eventually became too big of a task to take on alone. As humanity grew and learned to protect themselves, Airy/Wynrou felt unneeded and quietly retired into relative obscurity. He still watches over as the General of the Purifiers, but in his weakened state refuses to go into battle. 

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/818645.wynrou]official bio[/url]]
